name: @javis-dog/collector-mcp-server
description: Javi MCP server for agent self-report (ADR-0017). S5d: hand-written stdio JSON-RPC server with no runtime dependency beyond JD-C02 — `initialize` (known protocol versions echoed, else 2025-11-25), `ping`, `tools/list` and `tools/call` for `report_status` and `report_task` with fixed vocabularies, constant result texts that never echo input, fixed stderr strings only. Interop-tested with the official SDK client (dev dependency). Started by `javi mcp` (JD-C01).
